typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FilePath as string ('\\ cwcnhf501.wellsfargo.com\\DRSUAT\\WFSOpsKRIReporting\\DropZone\\Calypso\\LiborSofr_FallbackTrades'),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Trade Id} as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD SWDealId} as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD CCPTradeID} as string,
		{External Reference} as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{Sub Type} as string,
		{CounterParty Attribute WF_InterCoClassification} as string,
		{CounterParty Attribute INTERNAL} as string,
		{Trade Date} as string,
		{Maturity Date} as string,
		{Entered Date} as string,
		{Updated Date} as string,
		Trader as string,
		{Trade Currency} as string,
		{Product Description} as string,
		TradeStatus as string,
		Book as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD LEI_US} as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD LEI_CP} as string,
		{CounterParty Attribute LegalType} as string,
		{Trade Comment} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FileName = toString((substring(toString($FilePath), toInteger(97), toInteger(35)))),
		FileDate = toString((substring(toString($FilePath), toInteger(124), toInteger(8)))),
		Loaddate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LoadDate as string,
		TradeCurrency as string,
		SubType as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_LEI_CP as string,
		UpdatedDate as string,
		Trader as string,
		TradeID as string,
		FileName as string,
		ProductType as string,
		EnteredDate as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_SWDeal_ID as string,
		CounterPartyAttributeINTERNAL as string,
		MaturityDate as string,
		CounterPartyAttributeWF_InterCoClassification as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_LEI_US as string,
		CounterParty as string,
		ExternalReference as string,
		Book as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_CCPTrade_ID as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		CounterPartyAttributeLegalType as string,
		ProductDescription as string,
		TradeStatus as string,
		TradeComment as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate = Loaddate,
		TradeCurrency = {Trade Currency},
		SubType = {Sub Type},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_LEI_CP = {TRADE_KEYWORD LEI_CP},
		UpdatedDate = {Updated Date},
		Trader,
		TradeID = {Trade Id},
		FileName,
		ProductType = {Product Type},
		EnteredDate = {Entered Date},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_SWDeal_ID = {TRADE_KEYWORD SWDealId},
		CounterPartyAttributeINTERNAL = {CounterParty Attribute INTERNAL},
		MaturityDate = {Maturity Date},
		CounterPartyAttributeWF_InterCoClassification = {CounterParty Attribute WF_InterCoClassification},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_LEI_US = {TRADE_KEYWORD LEI_US},
		CounterParty,
		ExternalReference = {External Reference},
		Book,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_CCPTrade_ID = {TRADE_KEYWORD CCPTradeID},
		TradeDate = {Trade Date},
		CounterPartyAttributeLegalType = {CounterParty Attribute LegalType},
		ProductDescription = {Product Description},
		TradeStatus,
		TradeComment = {Trade Comment}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
